transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... well, I guess my eating has just been off for the past few weeks. I don't really mean to, but I keep skipping breakfast and lunch. And then... I just sort of pick at dinner, even when my wife cooks. My jeans are starting to feel pretty loose, so... yeah. I guess that's why I'm here.
Have you been trying to lose weight?
No, not really. I just... haven't had much of an appetite, I guess.
Has anything been worrying you or stressing you out lately?
Um... no. Not really. I mean, nothing specific comes to mind. Just... normal stuff, I guess. Nothing major.
Have you lost any weight recently?
Um... like I mentioned before, my jeans are getting pretty loose. So... yeah, probably. I haven't actually weighed myself or anything, though.
Have you had any episodes where you ate a large amount of food in a short period of time?
No. Like I said, I haven't really had an appetite. So... no, nothing like that.
Do you ever worry about your weight?
Um... no. Not really. I just... I don't really pay much attention to it, I guess.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?
No. Um... not at all. Like I said, it's just not something I really care about.
Do you think you would be upset if you gained back the weight you've lost?
Um... no. I don't think so. It just... it wouldn't really matter to me.
Do you think you would be happy if you were a bit thinner than you are now?
I mean... I don't really think about it. I guess it wouldn't make a difference either way.
Are you afraid of eating?
No. Um... I'm not afraid of it. I just eat when I'm hungry, I guess.
Do you find food less enjoyable than you used to?

I guess so. Um... my eating has just been kind of off for the past few weeks. Like, I'll skip breakfast and lunch without really meaning to. And then... even if my wife cooks dinner, I just sort of pick at it. My jeans are starting to feel a little loose, so... yeah. I just haven't really been into it.
Do you feel like you have less interest in food than you used to?
Yeah. Um... I guess so. Like I said, I just haven't really cared about it lately.
Do you think your lack of appetite is related to your mood?

Um... maybe. I guess I've just been feeling kind of... flat lately. Like, most days I wake up and there's just this heavy feeling. The apartment is just... too quiet. I don't even really try to pick up my guitar, it doesn't really lift me up or anything right now. So... yeah, I guess it could be that.
Is your lack of appetite because you're just not interested in food or is there another reason?
Um... no, I don't think so. I just... I'm just not really interested in it.
Do you think your lack of interest in food is related to your feelings of being flat lately?
Um... probably. I haven't really thought about it that much. Just... yeah, I guess they kind of go together.
Do you think your heavy feeling and lack of interest in things like playing guitar are related to your lack of appetite?
Um... I don't really know. I guess it's all just kind of part of the same thing. I haven't really... analyzed it that much.
Do you think something is bothering you that's causing you to not feel like eating?
Um... no, not really. There's not... nothing specific that's bothering me, I don't think. I just... I don't know, I just don't really care about eating right now.
Do you think your lack of appetite is because of the way you've been feeling emotionally?
I mean... maybe? I don't really know. Like I said, I just... I'm just not hungry. I haven't really thought about if it's connected to... my emotions or whatever.
Do you think your lack of appetite is more because of how you're feeling physically or how you're feeling emotionally?

I... I really couldn't tell you. I don't feel sick physically, if that's what you mean, but... I don't know. Like I said, I just don't have the urge to eat. I haven't really tried to figure out which one it is.
Are you avoiding food because you're worried about what might happen if you eat?
No... no, I'm not worried about anything happening. I just... I just don't want to eat. That's all.
